name: billie-dark-y2k-grid
image_vibe: dark Y2K, high-key, mysterious, playful, candid

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 2x2 photo grid / collage of one original adult woman in portrait photography style. Use a plain high-key white background so attention stays on the model, with soft even studio lighting that reveals facial features. Contrast a midnight-black sequin outfit and copper hair against the white background.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with medium-length wavy auburn/copper hair, large light icy-blue eyes, natural freckles, clear realistic skin, and minimalist no-makeup makeup with a light peach/nude lip. She wears a strapless midnight-black sequin bustier/corset, a gold omega-symbol choker, and stacked thick silver and gold metal bangles. Use an original non-celebrity identity; do not reproduce Billie Eilish or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Arrange four equal portrait frames in a clean 2x2 grid. Top-left: intense mysterious mood with direct impactful eye contact. Top-right: playful bored mood with one hand resting against the cheek. Bottom-left: confident expression with a slight smile and one hand placed beneath the chin. Bottom-right: candid open laugh in side profile with visible teeth. Keep the same adult subject, hair, outfit, accessories, white high-key background, and portrait scale consistent across all four frames.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use soft, even studio lighting across every frame, with gentle facial modeling, clean high-key whites, realistic sequin sparkle, natural skin texture, and a strong black-and-copper contrast. The emotional sequence moves from mysterious to playful to confident to candid joy.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait photography, crisp 2x2 contact-sheet alignment, equal frame spacing, consistent identity and wardrobe across frames, neutral white background, clean editorial finish, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 2x2 photo grid portrait series of one original adult woman with medium-length wavy auburn-copper hair, large icy-blue eyes, natural freckles, clear realistic skin, minimalist no-makeup makeup and a light peach-nude lip. She wears a strapless midnight-black sequin bustier/corset, gold omega-symbol choker, and stacked silver-and-gold bangles. Plain high-key white background, soft even studio lighting, strong contrast between the black outfit, copper hair and white background. Top-left intense mysterious direct eye contact; top-right playful boredom with hand on cheek; bottom-left confident slight smile with hand beneath chin; bottom-right candid open laugh in side profile with visible teeth. Keep the original adult identity, hair, makeup, outfit, accessories, lighting and portrait scale consistent across all four frames. No public-figure likeness.
